info.name: Letta Sources API
info.description:
REST API for Letta, the stateful agents platform. Manage agents, memory blocks, archival passages, sources, custom tools, MCP servers, multi-agent groups, runs, and streaming responses. Available as Letta Cloud (managed) at https://api.letta.com/v1 and as the self-hosted open-source server (Apache-2.0) typically run at http://localhost:8283.

Contact Support:
 Name: Letta
 Email: support@letta.com

request.description:
Get aggregated metadata for all sources in an organization.

Returns structured metadata including:
- Total number of sources
- Total number of files across all sources
- Total size of all files
- Per-source breakdown with file details (file_name, file_size per file) if include_detailed_per_source_metadata is True
